name: KiWay Via Stitching
description: Preview net-aware copper-zone via stitching with geometric clearance exclusions.
description_full: Generates a reviewed stitching grid inside the board or selected bounds, optionally constrained to filled target-net copper. It rejects footprint bodies, other-net tracks, vias, zones, keepouts, and drawings, previews accepted and rejected candidates, and commits a removable native KiCad group.
